name: TSMC Advanced Backend Fab 6, Zhunan

process_nodes.label: SoIC
process_nodes.note: TSMC described the fab as ready to mass-produce SoIC, and later reporting calls SoIC its main capacity driver.

summary: TSMC's advanced packaging and test plant in the Zhunan Science Park, Miaoli County, which TSMC described as its first backend fab to combine automated packaging and testing under one roof. Work on it started in 2020 and TSMC announced its opening in June 2023, calling it the company's largest backend fab: a 14.3-hectare base with a cleanroom bigger than those of its other backend fabs put together. It was set up for SoIC mass production and also handles InFO, CoWoS and testing, with an estimated capacity of more than one million 12-inch wafer equivalents a year. Reporting in April 2026 still described SoIC as the plant's main capacity driver.

location.address: 1, Kezhuan 1st Rd., Zhunan Township, Miaoli 350-012, Taiwan

metrics.note: 12-inch (300 mm) wafer equivalents per year of 3DFabric processes; more than 10 million test hours a year were also cited.
